meetings.title: Tokyo One-Day Tour
meetings.global_goals: Agree on a single one-day itinerary in Tokyo that fits a reasonable pace, stays within a modest budget, and accounts for basic transit and meal timing.

participants.name: Daniel Cho
participants.background: A software engineer on a short business trip who has one full free day and wants a compact but memorable city experience.
participants.preferences: Likes clear planning, predictable travel times, and a balanced mix of walking and sitting; dislikes long queue-heavy detours and expensive add-ons; prioritizes historical sites, good public transit connections, and keeping the day on schedule; wants no more than one splurge stop.
participants.personal_goals: See the Tokyo National Museum, browse Ameyoko Market, and have dinner at a conveyor-belt sushi place.

participants.name: Priya Nair
participants.background: A culinary blogger from Mumbai visiting Tokyo for the first time, with an interest in neighborhoods and everyday local life.
participants.preferences: Likes food-focused stops, bustling local streets, and time for spontaneous browsing; dislikes overly rigid itineraries and very early starts; prioritizes trying regional snacks, visiting lively shopping areas, and having one special dessert stop; can handle moderate walking if food breaks are spaced out.
participants.personal_goals: Try matcha sweets in Asakusa, explore Kappabashi kitchenware street, and end the day at a depachika food hall.

participants.name: Mina Sato
participants.background: A freelance photographer who recently relocated to Tokyo and wants to make the most of a rare free day with visiting friends.
participants.preferences: Likes atmospheric streets, scenic viewpoints, and places with strong visual character; dislikes rushed schedules and overly crowded transit windows; prioritizes photogenic stops, efficient routing, and at least one relaxed meal break; prefers staying within a mid-range budget.
participants.personal_goals: Visit Senso-ji, walk through the Yanaka district, and catch sunset from Shibuya Sky.
